name: Amanera

address.street: Autopista 5 Carretera Rio San Juan Rio San Juan

insider_take: Perched on a coral bluff above one of the Caribbean's most celebrated surf breaks, Amanera is where barefoot luxury meets untamed Atlantic drama — an Aman sanctuary unlike any other.
whats_special: Amanera's 25 private casitas are nestled within a 900-acre nature reserve, each featuring a private plunge pool and sweeping views of Playa Grande's legendary 1-mile stretch of golden sand. The resort sits adjacent to the Playa Grande Golf Course , a Robert Trent Jones Sr.-designed masterpiece with ocean-facing holes considered among the most scenic in the Caribbean. Playa Grande Beach is one of the Dominican Republic's last undeveloped beaches , protected in part due to the Aman reserve — making it a rare, crowd-free stretch of coastline. The resort's architecture draws deeply from Dominican vernacular design , using local hardwoods, stone, and open-air pavilions that blur the boundary between interior and jungle.
pro_tip: Request a casita on the western end of the property for the most dramatic sunset views over the Atlantic. And don't sleep on the surf — Playa Grande offers consistent breaks suitable for both beginners and experienced surfers, with board rentals available through the resort's beach team.
dont_miss: A round at Playa Grande Golf Course — the oceanfront back nine is bucket-list material, with fairways carved directly along the cliff's edge. Exploring the Rio San Juan lagoon — a short drive away, the luminescent Laguna Gri-Gri offers boat tours through mangroves and is one of the region's best-kept secrets. The open-air spa — Amanera's wellness facilities are designed to immerse guests in the surrounding forest canopy, offering treatments rooted in local botanical traditions.
pros: Stunning clifftop location overlooking pristine Playa Grande beach
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Spacious pavilions with private pools and panoramic ocean views
Championship golf course designed by Robert Trent Jones
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Remote location requires planning for off-property activities
